title: Daily habit tracker
problem: Pick one or a few small habits, tick them off each day, and see how many days in a row you've kept them.
forWho: Anyone trying to start or keep a small daily habit (walking, reading, water, no phone after 10 pm).
timeToUse: 1 minute to set up, seconds per day

title: Family money saver
problem: Type what comes in and what goes out in a normal month, see what is left and where the money goes, and try what a few small cuts would add up to over a year.
forWho: Any household that wants to save a bit more each month.
needAtHand: Rough monthly amounts for rent or mortgage, bills, food and other spending

title: Weekly meal planner
problem: Decide the week's lunches and dinners once, list what each dish needs, and get one shopping list for the whole week.
forWho: Anyone who cooks for a household and is tired of deciding every day what to eat.
needAtHand: An idea of the dishes you usually cook

title: Family trip budget
problem: Add up the full cost of a trip for your family (travel, a place to stay, food and the rest) and compare two options side by side before you book.
forWho: Families choosing between two holiday options on a budget.
needAtHand: Ticket or fuel prices for each option
The price per night of the place to stay
A rough idea of daily food and activity costs

title: Mortgage offer comparison
problem: Compare up to three mortgage offers side by side and see your monthly payment, total interest and how much the loan really costs.
needAtHand: The price of the home and the deposit you can put down
Each offer's interest rate, term and fees

title: Mortgage comparison for Spain (in Spanish)
problem: Compare up to three mortgage offers side by side and see your monthly payment, total interest and the cash you need on signing day.
forWho: People buying a home in Spain, especially Catalonia, who read Spanish and have offers from banks or a broker.
needAtHand: Each offer's FEIN: interest rate, term, fees and required insurance
